race.title: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Handicap
race.verdict: EASTERN PEACE is a C&D winner from last winter and backed up her previous effort when fourth here 26 days ago, so she is fancied to resume winning ways with Billy Lee taking the reins, while Speckled Meadow rates the main danger from a lower all-weather mark and Sherekiya is respected with this trip expected to suit. EASTERN PEACE (IRE) SPECKLED MEADOW (IRE) SHEREKIYA (IRE)
